verdict.rationale: Vestd documents an online exercise workflow: the recipient submits an exercise request through the platform, and the admin reviews/processes it, confirming valuation and tax considerations, after which shares can be issued digitally with Companies House auto-updated (no paperwork for issuance). However, the evidence never explicitly describes an online payment mechanism as part of the exercise flow, and the process still requires manual admin review rather than a fully automated end-to-end flow. Missing for 10: explicit description of in-platform payment collection during exercise, and confirmation that share issuance is automatic/instant post-payment rather than admin-mediated.
